x_what: X70 (PREREG.md beside this file): the four DRAFT arm items for the Training session's arm chain (schema arm_chain_v1, backend x35): the ONE arm x70 (C0's argv + --ent-coef 0 = the CE-3d swap's argv minus the magnet) at seeds 7331-7334, at the swap forks' TRAINING pin 9e97cad5. REGISTERED, NOT LAUNCHED: this file carries NO GO. On the orchestrator's GO, copy `items` into a NEW chain file in this order and replace `go_by` with the GO and the registration's commit. The four forks need not run back to back (PREREG §3, §12): a chain may hold any prefix of the remaining items, in seed order, and no B1 run is ever paused for one. No cell of any cross is played before all four forks have passed their arm-end checks. Nothing here launches; `arm_chain_plan_x70.txt` is the plan these items produced at the registration.

x_pin.x_note: sha = the CE-3d swap forks' training pin (main.x35.batch.CE3D_PIN; ARM_PINS['x70']). base = the first CE-3d pin, where all three X70 crosses are PLAYED (as CE-3d's were). base_base = the production side pin.
